title: Drop In Medical Collections On Credit Reports After The 2022-23 Bureau Changes

source.name: Medical Debt Burden in the United States

notes: After Equifax, Experian and TransUnion stopped reporting paid medical debt and small unpaid medical collections starting in 2022-2023, analyses found medical-collections tradelines on credit reports fell by roughly 70%. Recalled from published CFPB/bureau reporting; not live-refreshed this run because outbound network access was unavailable in this session.
